name: PT Galva Technologies Tbk
summary: PT Galva Technologies Tbk supplies electronic products for corporate clients in Indonesia. It operates through three segments: IT Distribution, Business Solutions, and Document Solutions. It offers commercial display products, such as large-format display screens and digital signage; computers, projectors, and accessories; content creation products, including broadcast systems for TV channels; document solutions, such as document receiving, document scanning, data capture, indexing, policy printing production, document management system, and record management; and alarms, such as fire detection and advanced voice alarm.
